issue.title: test_every_tick_rebroadcasts_to_mounted_views fails under the parallel check lane, passes in isolation

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by sase-1ex.2 (note #1) and sase-1ex.11 (note #3), relayed by sase-1ex.land.
- FAIL: joined check ToolRun f5a02662134a9f53de0067538eb6ba90 (2026-10-02, launched by sase-1ex.2; 4-worker scoped lane, tree RSS peak 6.2 GiB) failed at tests/ace/tui/test_launch_context_source.py:669 with `AssertionError: assert ([LaunchContextState(...)] and False)` / `where False = all(<genexpr>)`. That is the per-view identity check after a tick rebroadcast.
- FAIL: sase-1ex.11--2 saw the same "launch_context rebroadcast" failure in a full just check on 2026-10-03 and said it reproduced on the base tree under load.
- PASS: both agents reran it in isolation and it passed on the base and patched trees. sase-1ex.land reran it 3x serially at master 9f8c4c529e on 2026-10-03: 3/3 passed (about 4s each).
Serial isolation passes; failures only appear in the parallel check lane under host load. Likely a tick or settle race: a view mounts or re-renders between the rebroadcast and the identity assertion.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/ace/tui/test_launch_context_source.py::test_every_tick_rebroadcasts_to_mounted_views (passes serially; fails under the full parallel check lane)

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ex.2 and sase-1ex.11. Two independent full-lane failures had no owning flake bead, and serial reruns pass.

Isolation pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider on the same tree passed (2.24s call). Matches serial-pass / parallel-fail. This phase did not touch launch context.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction in guarded full just check ToolRun c1e5f1b6aa25ee4082eed4ffd49b770d: tests/ace/tui/test_launch_context_source.py::test_every_tick_rebroadcasts_to_mounted_views failed with the LaunchContextState identity assertion after a tick rebroadcast. Parallel failure and focused pass; this implementation does not touch launch-context state.

Independent serial (non-xdist) reproduction at master 404b0e2ac2 by the sase-1eq.5.1 land agent: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/main/test_parser_root_help.py tests/prompt_command/test_export_save.py tests/gate_turn/test_followup_prompt.py tests/main/test_parser_machine.py tests/perf/test_agents_display_rebuild_guard.py tests/ace/tui/test_app_title.py tests/ace/tui/test_launch_context_source.py tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_limit_keys.py' failed test_every_tick_rebroadcasts_to_mounted_views with an AssertionError on LaunchContextState after the tick rebroadcast. 'pytest tests/ace/tui/test_launch_context_source.py' alone then passed (23 passed). So it is order-dependent in serial runs too, not only in the parallel lane. Proposed for +1 by phase sase-1eq.5.1.3 note #2; not caused by sase-1eq.5.1.
